card.title: Apologize for the Lie
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You showed me the rescue dog's photo, not the page saying he eats sofas.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I understand. Admit that hiding the sofa page changed my yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Before we feed him another one, say I should have had both pages.

mechanism: A accepts the dog's need for a home but seeks acknowledgment that selective disclosure distorted consent.
confusable: Unlike seeking property compensation alone, A must keep demanding the missing information be acknowledged.
comparison: The dog scene bargains around replacement furniture, unlike the party scene correcting a misdirected verbal apology.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
